customManagers.description: BuildStream elements: any value annotated with a '# renovate:' comment on the preceding line. Covers `<tool>_version:` variables, `track:` pins and pinned tarball URLs.

packageRules.description: Never automerge GitHub Actions bumps: digest pinning blunts tag-rewriting but not a compromised release under a new SHA. Workflows here handle mergeraptor tokens, cosign signing, and packages:write, so every action update gets human review (mirrors the custom.regex gate below).

Upstream software pinned in BuildStream elements. Never automerge: the sha256/commit ref must be refreshed by `bst source track` (see .github/workflows/refresh-bst-refs.yml) and the image must pass `just verify` first.
kubectl follows the Kubernetes release cadence; skip pre-releases.
